verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a single marketing line saying Alloy streamlines perpetual KYC/KYB, AML, and fraud checks with 'fully auditable agentic automation'. That implies built-in AI agents performing compliance tasks, but nothing shows a user-facing assistant that users can hand tasks to. The ML model and workflow automation evidence describes adjacent features, not an assistant. Missing for 10: documented in-product AI assistant interface, description of which tasks can be delegated and how, first-party docs beyond homepage marketing, independent or hands-on corroboration.
